title.en: Screenshot storage for issues filed from Discord
title.zh: Discord 回報 issue 的截圖存放區

description.en: Stores the screenshots for GitHub issues that the 自由工坊 Discord helper bot files after a reporter or admin confirms the draft. Discord attachment links expire; these copies stay until someone removes them.
description.zh: 存放自由工坊 Discord 小幫手 bot 開立 GitHub issue 時附上的截圖，回報者或管理員確認草稿後才會開立。Discord 附件連結會過期，這裡的副本會一直留著，直到有人移除。

eyebrow.en: Storage repo · 自由工坊 Discord
eyebrow.zh: 存放用 repo · 自由工坊 Discord

lede.en: When someone reports a problem in the 自由工坊 Discord, a helper bot drafts a GitHub issue. After the reporter or an admin confirms the draft, the bot strips each screenshot's metadata, commits it here, and links it from the issue.
lede.zh: 有人在自由工坊 Discord 回報問題時，小幫手 bot 會先擬好 GitHub issue 草稿。回報者或管理員確認之後，bot 會移除截圖的中繼資料、提交到這個 repo，再在 issue 裡附上連結。

meta.en: One screenshot, from Discord to the issue
meta.zh: 一張截圖，從 Discord 到 issue

title.en: Confirmed first, cleaned, filed by path.
title.zh: 先確認、再清理、照路徑歸檔。

intro.en: The repository holds images only. The bot that files the issues lives elsewhere.
intro.zh: 這個 repo 只放圖片，開 issue 的 bot 不在這裡。

title.en: Nothing lands before a person confirms
title.zh: 有人確認之後才會存進來

body.en: The bot drafts the issue in Discord first. Screenshots are committed here only after the reporter or an admin confirms that draft.
body.zh: bot 會先在 Discord 裡擬好 issue 草稿，等回報者或管理員確認之後，截圖才會提交到這裡。

title.zh: 每個檔案都有固定路徑

body.en: Files land at ///-.: the repository the issue was filed in, the month, the Discord draft ID, and the screenshot number.
body.zh: 檔案會存在 ///-.：依序是 issue 所在的 repo、月份、Discord 草稿編號和第幾張截圖。

body.en: Photos can carry EXIF data such as location and device details. The bot strips it before upload, and a check of the stored file on 2026-09-30 found no metadata.
body.zh: 照片可能帶有位置、裝置等 EXIF 資訊。bot 會在上傳前移除；2026-09-30 檢查存放的檔案，沒有找到任何中繼資料。

intro.en: Screenshots sometimes show more than intended, such as names, email addresses, or tokens. If a secret was exposed, rotate it first: deleting the image does not undo the exposure.
intro.zh: 截圖有時會拍到不該公開的東西，例如姓名、email 或 token。如果外洩的是密碼或金鑰，請先更換：刪掉圖片並不能讓外洩的資訊收回來。

body.en: Note the issue and the screenshot number, or the file path in this repository.
body.zh: 記下是哪個 issue、第幾張截圖，或是這個 repo 裡的檔案路徑。

body.en: Ask an admin in the 自由工坊 Discord. If you are not in the Discord, open an issue in this repository. Name the file; do not attach the image again.
body.zh: 在自由工坊 Discord 找管理員；不在 Discord 的話，就在這個 repo 開 issue。寫出檔案位置就好，不要再附一次圖片。

body.en: The file is deleted from main and the issue is edited to drop the link. Older commits still hold the file until the Git history is rewritten.
body.zh: 維護者會從 main 刪除檔案，並編輯 issue 拿掉連結。在改寫 Git 歷史之前，舊的 commit 裡仍然留有這個檔案。

intro.en: Set up in September 2026. So far it holds one screenshot, from a closed test issue.
intro.zh: 2026 年 9 月建立，目前只存了一張截圖，來自一個已關閉的測試 issue。

works.en: Screenshots stored by path and linked from issues through raw.githubusercontent.com
works.zh: 截圖依路徑存放，issue 透過 raw.githubusercontent.com 連結

works.en: EXIF stripped before upload; the stored file had no metadata when checked on 2026-09-30
works.zh: 上傳前移除 EXIF；2026-09-30 檢查存放的檔案，沒有任何中繼資料

works.en: This project page publishes only site/, never the stored images
works.zh: 專案介紹頁只發佈 site/，不會發佈存放的圖片

limits.en: The repository is public, so a confirmed screenshot is public too. Confirming the draft is the privacy check
limits.zh: repo 是公開的，確認過的截圖也就公開了；確認草稿那一步，就是隱私把關

limits.en: Deleting a file breaks the issue's image link but does not erase it from Git history
limits.zh: 刪除檔案會讓 issue 裡的圖片連結失效，但不會把它從 Git 歷史裡抹掉

limits.en: The bot's code is not in this repository
limits.zh: bot 的程式碼不在這個 repo 裡

intro.en: The helper bot can draft the issue inside Discord. The screenshot reaches this repo only after the reporter or an admin agrees.
intro.zh: 小幫手 bot 可以先在 Discord 裡把 issue 寫成草稿。截圖要等回報者或管理員同意，才進得了這個 repo。

note.en: Someone describes the problem in the 自由工坊 Discord, and the bot writes the draft there.
note.zh: 有人在自由工坊 Discord 把問題講出來，bot 就在那邊起草。

note.en: The reporter or an admin has to be the one who agrees. Before that, nothing here is committed.
note.zh: 同意的人得是回報者或管理員。少了這一步，這裡不會多出檔案。

note.en: The bot strips EXIF, commits the image on main, and the issue points at raw.githubusercontent.com.
note.zh: bot 拿掉 EXIF，把圖交上 main，issue 再指向 raw.githubusercontent.com。

ticks.en: no file before a person agrees
a yes means anyone can see it

caption.en: Discord attachment links expire, so a confirmed shot needs a file that stays. This repo is public, and the bot's code is not in it.
caption.zh: Discord 的附件連結會過期，所以確認過的圖才需要一個留得住的檔。這個 repo 是公開的，bot 的程式也不在這裡。

intro.en: The folders say which repo the issue belongs to, and which month the file went in. The file name is the Discord draft.
intro.zh: 前面的資料夾告訴你這張 issue 屬於哪個 repo、落在哪一個月。檔名就是那份 Discord 草稿。

note.en: The first two folders are the owner and the repository where that issue was opened.
note.zh: 最前面兩層是 owner 和 repo，issue 就是開在那裡。

note.en: The next folder is the year and the month, written YYYY-MM.
note.zh: 再往下一層是年份和月份，寫法是 YYYY-MM。

note.en: The name joins the Discord draft id, a hyphen, the shot number, and the extension.
note.zh: 檔名把草稿編號、一個連字號、第幾張和副檔名接在一起。

note.en: The issue reaches that file on main through raw.githubusercontent.com.
note.zh: issue 經由 raw.githubusercontent.com，連到 main 上的這個檔。

ticks.zh: 編號、連字號、張數、副檔名

caption.en: The project page is built from site/ alone and does not publish these stored shots.
caption.zh: 專案介紹頁只從 site/ 建出來，不會把這些存檔的圖發佈出去。

intro.en: Ask an admin in the 自由工坊 Discord. If you are outside it, open an issue in this repository.
intro.zh: 去自由工坊 Discord 找管理員。人不在裡面，就在這個 repo 開一張 issue。

note.en: Give the issue and the shot number, or the path. Do not attach the picture again.
note.zh: 寫出是哪張 issue、第幾張，或是路徑。請求裡不要再附上那張圖。

note.en: A maintainer removes that file from the main branch.
note.zh: 維護者會把這個檔從 main 分支拿掉。

note.en: The issue is edited too, so that picture link stops working.
note.zh: issue 也會改一版，圖片連結就打不開了。

note.en: Commits from before that delete still contain the file, unless someone rewrites history.
note.zh: 這次刪除之前的 commit 仍留著檔案，除非有人改寫歷史。

ticks.en: name it, and do not reattach

ticks.zh: main 上的檔和連結都沒了

ticks.en: older commits still hold a copy
ticks.zh: 更早的 commit 還留著

caption.en: If the picture shows a password, a token, or a key, rotate it before you ask. Removing the file does not pull that secret back.
caption.zh: 圖裡如果有密碼、token 或金鑰，提出之前先換掉。刪掉檔案，並不會把已經外洩的內容收回來。
